messages:
Priya (eng-oncall): :rotating_light: Alert: Canary pool c-17 is showing spike in 500s for streaming pull endpoint after this morning's client adapter rollout. Severity-2 for now.

incident-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-2765432 - canary client protocol mismatch. Pager: Priya. Links: https://redwood.incidents/2765432

Priya (eng-oncall): Quick summary: client runtime v3.8.0 introduced a compact cursor encoding (skiplist) to reduce payloads. Canaries are rejecting some cursors with 400/500 errors when tokens contain the new marker.

Leo (eng): Seen it locally. Cursor decode path throws on certain base64 variants, ends up returning 500 upstream. Repro steps: call POST /v2/streaming/pull with cursor header `X-Redwood-Cursor: skp_...`

Priya (eng-oncall): Affected canary instances ~20% error rate, latency up ~300ms. Early customer reports from two enterprise tenants seeing degraded streaming resumes. Emily, can you surface which customers?

Emily (customer-success): Confirming two customers (AcmeHealth, ShopLayer) reported sessions dropping and reconnect loops around 09:12-09:40 PT. CS is on call with AcmeHealth now.

Tanya (eng-sre): Metrics: error budget for streaming route breached on canary ring. Canary healthcheck failing threshold hit. Canary traffic automatically routed to baseline, but some customers pinned to canary UX are impacted.

Priya (eng-oncall): Immediate mitigation options: 1) kill feature flag for client adapter rollout (FF:client-v3-compact-cursor) 2) rollback the release in canary 3) quick server-side shim to accept both encodings. Thoughts?

Rob (eng-platform): Kill-FF is fastest. Toggle will stop new client adapters from being treated as compact and route them to compatibility decoder. I can flip it.

Leo (eng): Server shim plausible but risk additional regressions under time pressure. I recommend FF kill then patch in next deploy.

Priya (eng-oncall): Do the kill-flag, Rob. Also start a rollback plan if errors don't drop in 3m.

deploy-bot: Feature flag toggle queued: client-v3-compact-cursor -> OFF (initiated by Rob).

Rob (eng-platform): Done. Flag OFF. Monitoring.

Tanya (eng-sre): Error rate down to 6% from 20% on canary in 90s. Latency trending back to baseline. Canary health passing again.

Priya (eng-oncall): Good. Contacting CS and affected customers to confirm recovery. Emily?

Emily (customer-success): AcmeHealth says reconnect loops stopped and streams resuming. ShopLayer reporting fewer dropped sessions, will confirm in 10m.

Fae (support): Logging note: link to diagnostics from affected sessions: https://logs.redwood/internal/2765432/canary. Add to incident ticket.

Priya (eng-oncall): Triage notes: root cause likely client/runtime v3.8.0 introduced unguarded compact cursor marker `skp_` which server decoder didn't accept; FF expected to gate behavior but clients already upgraded. Action items:
- Short term: FF kill (done).
- Medium term: server-side shim to accept both cursor encodings (Leo owns).
- Long term: Harden canary checks for decoder changes and add integration test for cursor variants (Tanya + Rob).

Leo (eng): I'll open PR for shim and add unit tests. Patch target: 3.8.1.

Priya (eng-oncall): Handoff: I'm going off shift in 20m. Tanya, you become primary until EO. Please keep incident ticket status updated and runbook link: https://runbooks/redwood/streaming-cursor-compat.md

Tanya (eng-sre): Acknowledged. Will monitor customer confirmations and track the PR.

Priya (eng-oncall): Postmortem required. Assigning: Leo (cause + fix), Tanya (monitoring + detection), Rob (release gating + FF runbook). Emily to coordinate customer comms.

incident-bot: Incident severity downgraded to S3. Updated incident timeline and owner fields.

Rob (eng-platform): Quick note for postmortem — add a checklist for forced FF rollbacks and automated customer pin detection.

Emily (customer-success): I'll draft a short customer-facing note for affected tenants, waiting for final confirmation from ShopLayer.

Fae (support): Marking ticket for follow-up and adding logs to support case.

Priya (eng-oncall): Thanks all. Leaving handoff. :wave: Tanya, takeover please.

Tanya (eng-sre): Taking over. Will update 2765432 with new PR link & ETA for server patch.
